program.name: Bell Core Long
program.subject: Core & abs
program.blurb: Long core sessions with one kettlebell: carries and holds, a rotation EMOM, then a circuit.
program.about: The core trained with one kettlebell in three ways. Suitcase marches, waiter walks and bottoms-up holds make it brace; windmills, halos and seated passes on the minute make it rotate; and a circuit of pull-throughs, get-ups and passes ties it together. Three days rotate. Abs finish every session. Level II adds reps and Level III moves you one weight up.
program.split: Bell carries & holds / bell rotation EMOM / bell core circuit
